explanation: I used `WP_HTML_Processor::create_fragment()` to parse the fragment in BODY context, then walked tokens with `next_token()`, appending only ordinary `#text` nodes plus opener text from `TITLE` and `TEXTAREA` tokens via `get_modifiable_text()`. I truncated the accumulated UTF-8 text by code points with `mb_strlen`/`mb_substr`, with a `preg_split('//u', ...)` fallback if mbstring is unavailable.
